name: Balaur
isnote: Described as a dromaeosaurid (Csiki et al. 2010; Brusatte et al. 2013); Cau et al. (2015) recovered it as a flightless avialan; it may also be a junior synonym of Elopteryx.
sum: Stocky paravian from the Maastrichtian of Hațeg, Romania, of debated position.
holotype: FGGUB R. 1580–1585, found in 1997 by Dan Grigorescu, Hațeg region, Romania.
material: The holotype and referred specimens from the Densuș-Ciula and Sebeș formations.
biology: Lived on Hațeg Island, a subtropical island of the European archipelago about 70 million years ago.
author: Csiki et al. 2010
